sources.entry: claude-plugins-official — Official plugin resources and examples for extending Claude-based workflows.
Official Plugin Directory by Anthropic - Anthropic's official, curated directory of high-quality Claude Code plugins, installable from within Claude Code.

summary.one_liner: A curated marketplace repository of official and third-party plugins for Claude Code, installable through Claude Code's plugin system.
summary.what_it_does: This repository is a directory of plugins for Claude Code, split into /plugins for internal plugins maintained by Anthropic and /external_plugins for third-party partner and community plugins. Plugins are installed with the command /plugin install {plugin-name}@claude-plugins-official or by browsing /plugin > Discover. The README describes the standard plugin layout: a .claude-plugin/plugin.json manifest, optional .mcp.json for MCP server configuration, and optional commands, agents, and skills directories. It also documents a marketplace feature for bundling SKILL.md skills that lack a manifest, using strict: false and an explicit skills array. Plugin names are described as immutable slugs, with a renames map for migrating any unavoidable changes. The README includes a reference internal plugin at /plugins/example-plugin and a submission form for external plugins.
use_cases: Find and install plugins for Claude Code
Browse curated third-party Claude Code extensions
Create a new Claude Code plugin using the documented structure
Bundle existing SKILL.md skills into a marketplace entry
Submit a plugin for inclusion in the marketplace
Configure MCP servers inside a Claude Code plugin
how_to_run: Or browse for a plugin in /plugin > Discover
notable: Splits plugins into internal Anthropic-maintained (/plugins) and third-party (/external_plugins) directories
Documents an immutable plugin name policy with a renames map for auto-migrating installs
Supports skill-bundle entries that expose SKILL.md directories without a plugin.json manifest
Installable directly from within Claude Code's plugin system
caveats: Anthropic does not control what MCP servers, files, or software plugins include and cannot verify they work as intended or will not change, so users must vet plugins before installing
External plugins require a submission form and must pass quality and security review before approval
Individual plugin licenses are in each linked plugin, not in this repository
